translation_notes: Single .add() call, so no @prefix/@graph: the draft's `@prefix rdf: <...>` was dead weight (rdf: never appears in the body -- RDF is imported but unused here) and `graph += g{ ... }` used the forbidden `+=` degradation. Replaced with `+{ {root} {FORGEFED.forkedFrom} {repository} }(graph)`: the call suffix reads `graph` -- the function's own parameter, a bare name, still any Python expression per current-graph.md -- directly, one line cheaper than declaring `@graph graph` for a graph touched exactly once.

Predicate FORGEFED.forkedFrom stays a Python attribute-access interpolation `{FORGEFED.forkedFrom}`, not a prefixed name: no @prefix for the ForgeFed vocabulary was declared (would need inventing a prefix the source file never uses), and the construction table does not require rewriting an already-idiomatic namespace-object dereference into `prefix:local`.

Context shim: swh.indexer.namespaces and metadata_mapping.base are not importable standalone (swh is not installed; `.base` is a sibling-package relative import) -- context_shim.py transcribes swh/indexer/namespaces.py and the produce_terms decorator VERBATIM from the local clone (corpus/repos/SoftwareHeritage__swh-indexer/), confirming FORGEFED = https://forgefed.org/ns# matches the docstring. BaseExtrinsicMapping/JsonMapping are name-only stand-ins: unused by the region's own body.

The docstring's doctest text (`>>> root = URIRef(...)`) is a Python string literal, not code -- left byte-for-byte identical to original.py; the earlier draft had silently rewritten it to `<http://example.org/test-fork>` inside the string, which this pair fixes back.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: URIRef(v["html_url"]) becomes `f<{v["html_url"]}>` (the guard ensures a str, no @base in scope; URIRef("") is kept on the empty-string case); `@graph graph` + `+{ }` replaces the call suffix `(graph)`, which the metric counts 9 tokens higher here.
No exception to the symmetry. Metric observation: with a call suffix, `f<{x}>` counts like `{URIRef(x)}`; under `@graph` it counts like `{x}`.
